definitions.technical_candidate: New V3 code/CI may be PASS while economic strategy utility remains UNKNOWN.
definitions.suitable_setup: Prospective same-clock Kraken EUR tradable market and time-stamped valid setup, with any required stop/stage2 execution facts known at decision time.
definitions.buy: BUY_SCOUT only after full independent risk and fee check plus valid stop below ask and stage2 confirmation above ask; no fabricated BUY on missing core evidence.
definitions.trade: Only executed Paper/Shadow fill tracked with actual assumptions, 6h/24h path and realized model costs; an MFE proxy or model suggestion is not a trade.
definitions.strategy_success: MORE VALID NET-POSITIVE PUBLISHED COMPARABLE TRADE OPPORTUNITIES AFTER COSTS, with bounded risk and no rise in false positives/stop-outs, not raw BUY count.
definitions.unknown: Optional data absent is neutral/context unavailable; required source/price/risk proof unavailable is UNKNOWN/NO_EXECUTION and counted as input failure, not bearish strategy rejection.

package_order.work: Use proven source→evaluator input adapter in isolated offline successor; safe categorical (not raw-secret) COIN_ATTACH error accounting; retain candidate/PIT timestamps and compare baseline only when same-snapshot official replay matching is proven. Allow missing optional H/news/onchain fields neutrally, but never generate a trade without genuine core risk data.
package_order.exit: Independent in-contract 1m/5m/15m closed OHLC/volume/ATR/structure/ask data are provenance-valid; technical skips reported separately; no repeated four-case API batch; no new resource or model calls without explicit budget.
package_order.risk: Don't confuse 0/1731 historical V2R4 input with a 2026-10-11 input-ready active runtime.

package_order.work: Finish *independent* same-snapshot full V2R4-vs-B strategy decision comparison in separately gated research: old EXTENDED WAIT/REJECT is historical; a fresh closed 1–3h base/pullback + reclaim and known-at Kraken EUR data may request a single NEW full evaluator review using exact frozen cost/stop/stage2/anti-chase. Measure usable BUY conversion, valid stops, correct REJECT, net expectancy and later drawdown, not just eligibility. The new policy must actually reach a different decision pathway; don't merely feed the old prompt more data.
package_order.exit: One reproducible frozen B configuration, positive/negative synthetic tests, prospective matched decisions, observed valid entry/stop/stage2 proposals, actual Paper economic followups; reject if no net edge, not prolong on calendar alone.
package_order.not_authorized: Current code is only review eligibility, no automatic model calls/BUY. Any prospective strategy-changing shadow or additional model budget still needs separate approval.

package_order.work: Separate successor B2 hypothesis: WAIT with temporary unfavorable price may regain confirmed trigger on a later fresh event; distinguish still watchable from dead setup and re-evaluate exactly once on verified new market input. Keep blocked risk factors; prevent 30–60min TTL nuisance, duplicate rechecks, live orders. Do NOT combine this parameter/TTL change with B second-leg test.
package_order.exit: Funnel WAIT→watchable→fresh trigger→full model recheck→valid BUY proposal with precision and costs; bounded de-duped number of rechecks, stop when economic gate fails.

package_order.work: Independently test only if B/B2 show a gap: IGNITION (early impulse vs already-run), CONTINUITY (trend pause/resumption), resistance BREAKOUT/reclaim with a closed structure, REVERSAL only with convincing confirmation and market/regime safeguards. Keep long-context 7d/30d non-veto, 1–3h refreshed setups, flexible 2–4 relevant soft factors rather than an aggregate 'all must pass' gate. Ranking scores are never a direct entry or sizing override.
package_order.exit: One versioned causal comparison per setup class against same-market-clock baseline; positive and adverse controls, rejections and false BUYs; no simultaneous sweeping of thresholds.

package_order.work: Preserve Kraken *online* public Spot-EUR pair metadata, min order, fresh bid/ask and spread. Full risk plan: stop below ask anchored to real structure/ATR, stage2 confirmation strictly above ask with TTL, scout 50 EUR + stage2 50 EUR, no adding losing trades, no lowering stops, no leverage or order rights. Fee 0.60% taker PER SIDE (1.2% roundtrip) plus spread+slippage and conservative fill/path assumptions. H4/H9/trailing and larger sizing only after enough actual mature paths and separate version release.
package_order.exit: Positive economic evidence after realistic costs and risk-adjusted drawdown; no false-looking profitable 'missed-move' replay using future MAE/MFE as prompt features.

package_order.work: Use existing 2h source radar and current source registry/candidates for independent search, source reliability scoring, retention/quarantine/reversible source change, and timestamp/provenance. Primary Kraken EUR order/execution truth; other exchanges, derivative, onchain, Smart Money, news, official macro, prediction odds are supplemental independent sensors. Deduplicate correlated repeated signals; missing optional source neutral, no automatic multi-veto. First prove actual unattended source-management E2E and source alpha at a later bounded source-only gate. Do not create jobs, scrape secrets, buy feeds, grant trading authority or increase Work cost.
package_order.exit: Each source has provenance, unique incremental role, known-at, failure mode, overlap class, KEEP/QUARANTINE/REPLACE/DEFER decision, and where warranted ONE source feature change research trail, not an automated new BUY rule.

package_order.work: Permanently observe only real known-at regime phase transitions Risk-off→stabilization→recovery/Risk-on, retain one compact event per transition and outcome join with matched candidates/negative controls. Use as context and stratification; never H1-like standalone veto or hindsight-adjusted threshold. Inherit ability in V4+ and separately authorized live successors.
package_order.exit: Measurable incremental prospective strategy benefit OR NO_ACTION_WARRANTED, without separate Work run/Push/route.

package_order.work: Only once entry B economic quality is knowable, separately assess potentially useful H2 derivatives; archived H3 fresh new-depth trial after separate disposition and new full approval; H6 additional price×volume not duplicate coin volume; H4 stop/TTL later; H5 event risk; H8 onchain; H9 execution fill; H10 Smart Money continuation after known-at Kraken outcome join (observation not copy trade); H11 prediction-market state. Each KEEP/REJECT/DEFER tied to its own last report, do not wait for all H layers before core B.
package_order.exit: Incremental OOS value and risk controls under cost model and same-clock candidate stream. A source count or association is not performance.

package_order.work: Freeze ONE distinct integrated V3 config of only retained individually evidenced components, compare to current frozen V2R4 on matched prospective same-snapshot candidate stream, including interactions and bad trades. One strategy-changing Shadow at a time. No untested H-layer bundle, no UI-dressed 'full V3' claims.
